moduleTitle_01: POPIA ni Vuxokoxoko bya Wena bya Xihundla
moduleIntro_01: Twisisa leswaku POPIA yi sirhelela yini, leswaku mpfumelelo wu laveka rini, ni leswaku i mani la faneleke ku tihlamulela loko datha ya wena yi tirhisiwa hi ndlela yo biha.
moduleIntro_02: Xiya, u lavisisa naswona u hlamula vuxisi bya WhatsApp, SMS ni imeyili, naswona u twisisa ndlela leyi vaxisi va kanganyisaka vanhu ha yona.
moduleIntro_03: Xiya ndlela leyi datha ya wena yi tirhisiwaka hi ndlela yo biha ha yona siku ni siku, naswona u aka mikhuva leyi yi hlayisaka yi sirhelelekile.
